The present Petition was listed on 5.7.2022, 18.10.2022, 15.11.2022, 17.1.2023, 21.2.2023, 29.1.2024, 22.8.2024. Since the order in the present Petition, which was reserved on 29.1.2024, could not be issued prior to the Members of this Commission, who formed part of the Coram, demitted office, the matter was relisted for hearing on 22.8.2024. Learned counsels for parties have submitted that the pleadings had been completed and arguments were heard, and accordingly, requested the Commission to issue the Order based on the information already on record. Considering the above, the Commission reserved the matter for Order. 14. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and Respondent No.1 and perused the documents available on record. We have considered the rival submissions of the parties. Respondent No.1 has not made any submission with regard to the principle laid down by the Hon`ble Supreme Court in **_Energy Watchdog Case_** with regard to the jurisdiction of the Commission. The Limited contention of Respondent No.1 is with regard to the change in the present arrangement _vis-à-vis_ the composite scheme, which was considered based on the arrangement considered by the Commission while passing the order dated 31.5.2021, in Petition No. 380/MP/2018. As per Respondent No.1, the Commission in the order in Petition No. 380/MP/2018 took into consideration the arrangements that were then subsisting (supplying power to Telangana and Exchange), which no longer exist.
